name: Nevinnye Ved'my
source:
This is a Harry Potter parody VN that has many old school point and click elements that a reminiscent of Monkey Island and the likes. You play as the protagonist Marcus Redblack, who is now in Azkaban for his crimes while at Hogwarts. Just what has he done and why is he there? That's what you will find out, as you dive back into the pensieve with him, to be guided by Sonya through your memories.

You will meet with four lovely girls, each representing the houses at Hogwarts, where your goal should be to solve the mystery of what has happened and corrupt these girls while in the process.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/Sad_Crab]Patreon page[/url]]

[url=https://wiki.teamsadcrab.com/]Wiki Walkthrough[/url]
translation:
这是一部戏仿《哈利·波特》的视觉小说，采用了许多让人想起《猴岛小英雄》等经典作品的点击式冒险设计。你扮演马库斯·雷德布莱克，他因在霍格沃茨犯下的罪行，如今被关进了阿兹卡班。他到底做了什么？为什么会落到这个地步？你将与他一同潜入冥想盆，在索尼娅的引导下重温记忆，找出答案。

你会结识四位可爱的女孩，分别来自霍格沃茨的四个学院。你要弄清过去究竟发生了什么，而在解开谜团的过程中，也会引诱这些女孩堕落。

[据[url=https://www.patreon.com/Sad_Crab]Patreon页面[/url]改编。]
